summary.en: People who study in China for more than 180 days apply for an X1 visa and then a residence permit for study.
summary.ru: Тем, кто учится в Китае дольше 180 дней, нужна виза X1, затем вид на жительство для учёбы.

summary.en: Part-time work or an internship off campus is allowed only with the approval of the school and a remark on the residence permit made by the public security exit-entry department (place and duration). Without the remark it is not allowed.
summary.ru: Подработка или стажировка вне университета возможна только с разрешения вуза и отметкой в виде на жительство от органов общественной безопасности (место и срок). Без отметки нельзя.

notes_for_reviewer: From the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (X1 visa) and National Immigration Administration regulation pages. work_during_study.allowed is null because work is conditional (school approval + permit remark). Post-study options, cost of living and recognition not collected. academic_year_start 09 is general knowledge (confirmed by university pages).
